tasks.short: Find potential customers and judge whether their technical needs fit the offer.

steps.what: Define target industries, technical needs and exclusion criteria.
Find matching accounts in existing records and public business directories.
Read account websites and reports for technical needs and buying signals.

loop.input: A fixed set of permitted account pages and reports, plus target criteria.
loop.output: Technical needs and buying signals, with source passages and dates.
loop.check: Require a source passage for every claim; leave unsupported fields unknown.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per account, at most ten documents; gaps go to the sales engineer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Technical needs appear in varied prose without shared fields.

steps.what: Combine findings and remove duplicate accounts in a prospect workbook.
Judge technical fit, commercial value and which accounts deserve discovery.
Create prospect records and assign discovery follow-up.

tasks.design: A scheduled job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} combines {CRM} records with permitted business-directory data from {OTHER}, then removes duplicates. A bounded reading loop produces source-linked account evidence; the sales engineer selects accounts, and configured {CRM} rules create discovery tasks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Account facts were scattered, and technical fit could not be reduced to directory filters.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster integration development and bounded text extraction reduce collection work. Qualification still needs technical judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Buying signals become stale. Public information rarely reveals budgets, constraints or internal decision makers.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a plausible engineering use case and distinguish a real need from superficial similarity.

ambition.what: Small industrial accounts previously skipped because technical prospect research cost too much.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less account searching and more discovery preparation. The engineer can prioritise technical discovery within agreed territory rules; pricing and territory rights do not change.

reach.learn: Buying roles, industry economics and the team's qualification definitions.

evidence.claim: Structured account filtering and deduplication can use deterministic rules.
Source-linked extraction can assist technical prospect research; the digest documents no direct sales-engineering case.
Personal prospect data needs a GDPR legal basis, purpose limits and retention controls.

assumptions: Shares and remaining time are planning estimates for active handling, excluding waiting.
The first build covers one target segment and a fixed set of permitted sources.
The priors support gathering automation, but technical qualification remains human.
The step map puts less time in meetings and mail than the supplied means prior.
EU GDPR and EU AI Act obligations apply; employee consultation depends on national rules and the proposed use.
unknowns: Available account identifiers and duplicate rates.
Permitted directory access, reuse rights and source costs.
Which technical criteria reliably predict useful discovery.
Current prospect-data legal basis and retention policy.
Applicable national employee consultation requirements.
research_questions: How accurately does source-linked extraction identify technical needs across different industries?
Which public signals predict a discovery conversation that becomes a qualified opportunity?
new_work: Review unsupported or stale account claims.
Maintain target filters and source connectors.

tasks.short: Win and renew orders, confirm terms, and coordinate delivery.

steps.what: Review account history, renewal dates, current pricing and delivery constraints.
Discuss requirements, handle objections and negotiate proposed terms with the customer.
Prepare a quotation using the configuration, price list and proposed terms.
Approve commercial exceptions and release the quotation to the customer.
Compare customer acceptance and purchase order against the released quotation.

loop.input: Customer acceptance and purchase order, plus the released quotation.
loop.output: Order fields with source passages; deterministic comparison produces discrepancies.
loop.check: Validate quantities, units, prices, currency and terms against the quotation; a person resolves differences.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per order; unreadable documents or unresolved differences remain manual.
loop.why_not_simpler: Customer documents and acceptance messages use inconsistent layouts and prose.

steps.what: Enter the accepted order and route it for fulfilment.
Confirm delivery arrangements with operations and the customer.

tasks.design: Connect {CRM}, {ERP} and {OPS_SYSTEM} to assemble order briefs, populate quotation templates and transfer approved order data. A bounded extraction loop reads customer documents, while deterministic checks flag differences; people approve quotation release and delivery commitments through {WORKFLOW}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Customer terms arrived in varied documents, and account, pricing and delivery data crossed separate systems.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured quotation templates and faster integration development reduce copying. Bounded extraction makes document differences easier to review.
tasks.still_hard: Nonstandard engineering scope, delivery uncertainty and disputed contract terms need expert resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Earn agreement, negotiate trade-offs and recognise commitments the supplier cannot safely make.

ambition.what: A renewal readiness review covering technical fit and delivery feasibility before the renewal discussion.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends less time assembling quotes and chasing order status, leaving more time for renewal discussions. Commercial approval and delivery commitment rights remain with their existing approvers.

reach.learn: Order validation, delivery terms and the distinction between customer requests and accepted commitments.

evidence.claim: Tacton CPQ supports rule-based configuration and quoting.
Meyn reports single-machine quoting falling from two days to a week to under 15 minutes; this vendor case supports quotation preparation, not negotiation automation.
Validated order transfer and delivery notifications can use deterministic integrations and workflows.

assumptions: Shares cover active handling across the named roles, excluding customer and approval waiting time.
The first build covers standard orders with existing validated configurations and pricing rules.
Configured quotation generation is the preferred starting point; system support must be confirmed.
The coordination-heavy prior fits the paperwork, while negotiation remains human.
EU GDPR and EU AI Act obligations apply; access and employee consultation depend on national rules.
unknowns: Quotation-template and approval capabilities of the current systems.
Order interfaces, duplicate prevention and rollback options.
Frequency and types of customer term discrepancies.
Who may approve discounts, contractual exceptions and delivery promises.
Applicable access and employee consultation requirements.
research_questions: How reliably can extraction preserve units, revision numbers and referenced contractual terms?
Which order checks prevent the most fulfilment rework?
new_work: Review extracted order fields and commercial differences.
Handle failed transfers and changed delivery availability.
Maintain pricing, template and validation rules.
Monitor duplicate prevention and approval logs.

tasks.short: Build and obtain approval for a sales plan to enter a new market.

steps.what: Compile sales history, margins and existing customer segments.
Read industry reports and competitor material for market needs and constraints.

loop.input: An approved research packet and the product capability catalogue.
loop.output: Source-linked needs, competitors, constraints and evidence gaps.
loop.check: Each factual claim must cite a passage and date; distinguish observations from assumptions.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair for at most twenty documents; unsupported conclusions go to the engineer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Research expresses market needs and constraints in varied narrative text.

steps.what: Interview potential buyers and partners about technical needs and adoption barriers.
Calculate segment economics, sales capacity and entry scenarios.
Write a sales plan with positioning, channels, milestones and risks.

loop.input: Reviewed evidence, calculated scenarios, discovery notes and a fixed plan template.
loop.output: A sales plan draft linking claims to evidence and marking recommendations as proposals.
loop.check: Reconcile every number to scenario outputs; flag unsupported claims and missing launch constraints.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair; unresolved sections remain blank for the engineer.
loop.why_not_simpler: A coherent proposal must connect narrative buyer evidence with scenario results.

steps.what: Choose the target segment, route to market and proposed pilot.
Approve the pilot budget, staffing and launch conditions.

tasks.design: A governed dataset joins {CRM} and {ERP} results for a market baseline in {BI}, while deterministic calculations generate entry scenarios. Bounded loops extract cited research and draft a plan in {DOCS}; people validate buyer assumptions and approve pilot commitments, then publish milestones to {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence gathering, scenario calculations and plan writing were separate jobs. Sparse market evidence still made strategy uncertain.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable calculations and faster connector development make scenario updates cheaper. Bounded drafting can organise evidence without deciding market entry.
tasks.still_hard: Market size, adoption barriers and channel incentives may be poorly observed. Good-looking plans can hide weak assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Test assumptions with buyers, judge strategic fit and accept responsibility for resource trade-offs.

ambition.what: Monthly continue, change or stop decisions for a new-market pilot.

tasks.altitude: Planning shifts from periodic document assembly to shorter evidence and scenario reviews. The engineer recommends pilot changes more often; the sales manager retains budget and launch approval.

reach.task: Evaluate a market-entry pilot against commercial milestones.
reach.learn: Unit economics, channel incentives and how to set meaningful stop conditions.

evidence.claim: Pipeline, margin and scenario calculations can be implemented deterministically.
Bounded extraction and drafting can assist evidence assembly; the digest contains no documented market-entry planning case.

assumptions: Shares cover active planning work across the named roles.
The first build supports one market-entry pilot and a reusable scenario model.
The judgement-heavy prior is retained: research assistance does not establish market demand.
Drafting savings are limited because human validation and approval remain substantial.
EU GDPR and EU AI Act obligations apply; national rules determine any employee consultation.
unknowns: Availability and comparability of sales and margin data.
Rights to reuse market research.
Current pilot budget authority and approval thresholds.
Access to prospective buyers for validation.
Applicable access and employee consultation requirements.
research_questions: Which early pilot measures predict durable commercial demand?
How often do generated plans overstate conclusions from sparse research?
new_work: Check research citations and evidence dates.
Maintain scenario formulas and assumption definitions.
Track pilot results against decision thresholds.
Revise drafts when buyer evidence contradicts the original plan.

tasks.short: Attend industry events to demonstrate products, build relationships and learn.

steps.what: Review the event programme and prepare technical talking points.

loop.input: Event programme, approved product material and target criteria.
loop.output: Session suggestions and technical talking points with source references.
loop.check: Product claims must trace to approved material; the engineer checks relevance and demonstration limits.
loop.stop: One brief and one repair per event; unsupported topics remain questions.
loop.why_not_simpler: Session descriptions and their relevance to technical needs are expressed in prose.

steps.what: Arrange attendance and meetings with relevant contacts.
Attend sessions, demonstrate products and discuss needs with attendees.
Write up event learning and add relevant contacts to account records.

loop.input: The engineer's event notes and contact details.
loop.output: Draft contact fields, learning points and explicit follow-up commitments.
loop.check: Trace commitments to notes, check account matches and exclude unsupported personal inferences.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per note batch; ambiguous contacts or commitments stay manual.
loop.why_not_simpler: Handwritten or free-text notes mix observations, names and promises.

steps.what: Assign follow-up actions and share technical learning with the sales team.

tasks.design: A bounded loop prepares an event brief from approved {DOCS} material, and configured {CALENDAR} features assist meeting arrangements. After attendance, a second bounded loop turns notes into reviewed {CRM} records and a learning summary in {DOCS}; configured follow-up rules assign internal tasks.
tasks.previous_blocker: The main value comes from live attendance. Preparation and follow-up were too fragmented to justify a separate tool.
tasks.enabler_now: Small drafting and note-extraction features can be attached to existing records and scheduling workflows.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected conversations, live demonstrations and interpreting weak industry signals remain situational.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust, adapt a demonstration and notice what people hesitate to say.
tasks.altitude: The week changes modestly: event preparation and write-up take less time, while attendance remains central. Decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Prepare a technically accurate event demonstration.
reach.learn: Demonstration safety, approved product claims and how to adapt explanations to different audiences.

evidence.claim: Configured scheduling and follow-up rules can reduce event administration.
Bounded drafting and note extraction can assist event paperwork; no direct event-attendance case appears in the digest.
Collecting event contact details does not itself establish permission for every later marketing use under GDPR.

assumptions: Shares represent active event work, excluding travel.
Most time remains live attendance, consistent with the strong human-work prior.
The proposed note flow uses notes the engineer supplies and does not require conversation recording.
Savings concern preparation and paperwork, not replacing event participation.
EU GDPR and EU AI Act obligations apply; national rules determine any employee consultation.
unknowns: Existing event scheduling and contact-capture capabilities.
Quality and format of event notes.
Rules for retaining and using event contact details.
Who owns follow-up after an event.
Applicable access and employee consultation requirements.
research_questions: Does faster follow-up improve qualified discovery without increasing irrelevant contact?
Which event observations are useful enough to retain in a shared learning summary?
new_work: Review extracted contacts and promised actions.
Remove stale event contacts and monitor overdue follow-up.

role.altitude: The sales engineer spends less time researching accounts, assembling quotations and rewriting plans. More time goes to technical discovery, renewal discussions and testing market assumptions; commercial and delivery approval rights remain with the designated roles.
reach: Sales representative: prepare stronger technical discovery.
Order clerk: resolve order discrepancies before fulfilment.
Sales manager: evaluate market-entry pilots using commercial evidence.
Demonstrator and product promoter: prepare accurate technical demonstrations.
skills_to_grow: Translate technical fit into explicit qualification criteria.
Check source quality and distinguish evidence from assumptions.
Understand order validation and contractual commitments.
Design buyer interviews and pilot decision thresholds.
Review bounded model outputs and diagnose integration exceptions.
role.ambitious_version: Offer smaller industrial buyers earlier technical discovery, provide renewal readiness reviews, and recommend monthly changes to market-entry pilots using current evidence.
